That night, as the beam swept its slow circle over the water, he wondered about the hands that had written it, the life it belonged to, and whether, somewhere, another keeper was reading his own forgotten words, tossed into the waves a decade before.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按下了静音键。路灯还亮着，橘黄色的光洒在空荡荡的马路上，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，车灯划出一道短暂的痕迹。便利店的玻璃门里透出一点暖光，值夜班的店员靠着柜台打瞌睡。远处传来垂直的风声，吹过高楼之间的缝隙，带着一点凉意。早点摊的老板刚开始生火，白色的蒸汽慢慢升起，混进夜色里。整座城市还没醒，却已经有人在为天亮做准备，一切都安静得像是在等待什么。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by asking a smaller copy of itself to solve a tiny piece of it\n- It keeps calling itself on smaller and smaller pieces until it reaches a problem so small it already knows the answer\n- Then all the small answers combine, step by step, to build the answer to the original big problem"}
